summary: Current V28 artifacts correspond and support the negative gate, but the reachable resume path can accept a receipt without execution-bound lineage. Endpoint timing is a closest-approach event not defined in the frozen prose.
scientific_result: C1 efficacy unsupported; COMPLETE_GATE_NOT_MET is supported.

gt_provenance.details: Dataset-cache endpoint plus frozen offset is retained as the scoring target; generated tracking, semantic, and surface/contact measurements are explicitly proxy-labeled.

score_normalization.details: Raw SI metrics are persisted. Threshold division is used only for candidate ranking and never uses prediction-derived maxima or means.

result_existence.details: All requested V28 outputs exist; all arm counts and claims match; C1 is correctly reported as unsupported and G1/downstream are not run.

dead_code.details: The claimed V23 metric is called. Several legacy metric/helper definitions are unreachable in V28 and should not be mistaken for the executed scorer.

scope.details: 48 sources x 3 offsets x 3 seeds x 10 replay arms, equal-budget controls and four ablations are present with failures retained. The amended, non-confirmatory, simulation-only ceiling is disclosed.

classifications: real_gt: cached dataset endpoint target with synthetic fixed offset

endpoint_time_event.saved_definition: Time of a frame within 1 mm of the trajectory-specific minimum target distance, choosing the one nearest the scheduled endpoint.

audit_only_alternate.description: Final position pass and timing pass: saved closest-approach event versus first entry into the same 10 cm window. Diagnostic only; no historical score changed.

v33_v35.reason: Original V33 runner does not enforce witness-captured cache digests or threshold immutability on reuse; current files match.

action_items: Preserve the failed V28 gate and historical metrics; do not change thresholds or exclude failures.
Require execution-bound lineage before any future V28 cache reuse.
Predeclare the endpoint timing event in a new experiment version; do not retrofit V28.
Use separately bound fail-closed V33 cache certification and assert proposed/original target equality before reuse.
Obtain cross-family review for accepted rather than provisional audit status.
